messages.content:
Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-boost-transcribe-medium-0105", "row_sha256": "6e7d1d6c3e78c6ea8974bd557d0f136950ada041c94c0f8b917c5b2fe80aa598", "mode": "/transcribe", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Remove true hesitation and accidental restarts. Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "could you forward the rehearsal recording from the west room to mara before thursday afternoon the file is called winter set run through three and it should stay as the original wav not the trimmed listening copy i want the full opening and the two pauses after the brass entrance because the conductor is checking how the room sounds when nobody is playing please send it to mara's archive address and copy devin so he can confirm that the label matches the folder on the drive if the upload page asks for a note say recorded on april ninth in room west and include the microphone position near the back wall don't add a new description from the program because that program still lists the old order of pieces the folder also has a scan of the sign in sheet and a short note from ellis those can remain where they are no need to forward them today i can check the access link after lunch if mara cannot open the wav please leave the file in place and tell me which message appears on her screen the rehearsal team has a planning call friday morning and they need the recording before that so forwarding it by thursday afternoon would be helpful thanks", "output": "Could you forward the rehearsal recording from the West Room to Mara before Thursday afternoon? The file is called Winter Set Run Through Three, and it should stay as the original WAV, not the trimmed listening copy. I want the full opening and the two pauses after the brass entrance because the conductor is checking how the room sounds when nobody is playing. Please send it to Mara's archive address and copy Devin so he can confirm that the label matches the folder on the drive. If the upload page asks for a note, say, “Recorded on April ninth in Room West,” and include the microphone position near the back wall. Don't add a new description from the program because that program still lists the old order of pieces. The folder also has a scan of the sign-in sheet and a short note from Ellis; those can remain where they are. No need to forward them today. I can check the access link after lunch. If Mara cannot open the WAV, please leave the file in place and tell me which message appears on her screen. The rehearsal team has a planning call Friday morning, and they need the recording before that, so forwarding it by Thursday afternoon would be helpful. Thanks."}]
